{{Quote|''Star Morning''. For most of the last few months, she's been way over in Farana, on the far side of the Corporate Sector.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], to [[Akanah Norand Goss Pell]]|<ref name="SoL">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref>}}
'''Farana''', also known as '''Farana Space''', was a region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] located within the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] portion of the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]], rimward of the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==Geography==
Farana, known as Farana Space,<ref name="EECR">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> was a remote area located in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]], rimward of the [[Trianii Space/Legends|Trianii Space]] and the [[Morellian Commonwealth/Legends|Morellian Commonwealth]], between the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] and the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. For long, the region had remained independent from galactic governments while building extensive ties between with the rest of the galaxy through trade and migration.<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
Farana was the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] region ruled by the [[Ocsin]] and named after the name of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Farana/Legends|Farana]]. The sector contained also some Ocsin colony worlds.<ref name="TEA" />

The Farana Space had become a [[Freestanding subsectors/Legends|freestanding subsector]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="EAOC" /> This meant that this remote area was poorly explored or insufficiently documented before the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial period]] and was only recognized as a potential sector by the Empire. Yet, the region was not given a formal sector status when incorporated into [[Imperial Space]] and was not represented in the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] for the time being.<ref name="TEA" />

The region was annexed by [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Zsinj]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]] and stayed in [[Zsinj's Empire|his territory]] until [[Battle of Dathomir (Hunt for Zsinj)|his death]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

In [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] came across the ''[[Star Morning]]'' and spent time with its occupants, the [[Fallanassi/Legends|Fallanassi]].<ref name="SoL">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref>
